diagnosis.literature_gap: On c101_21, community BKS ~ 11 vehicles / 1046 distance; current short-budget B1 solutions use ~32-34 vehicles. Gap is large and not explained by scoring alone.
diagnosis.primary_bottleneck_hypothesis: Construction opens far too many routes; ALNS with destroy_cap=3 and weak consolidation fails to compress fleet toward BKS. Route elimination and larger neighborhoods are the priority before LLM insertion discovery.
